description: This Java source file defines the 'HiveMqtt5ConsumerActor' class, an Akka actor responsible for receiving MQTT 5 messages from a HiveMQ broker, processing headers and payloads, and forwarding the messages within a connectivity framework. It includes methods for creating actor configuration, extracting message headers, payload, and topic details.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5ConsumerActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class for consuming MQTT 5 messages from HiveMQ, extracting headers and payloads, and forwarding them for further processing within a monitoring or message handling system.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates configuration props for instantiating the HiveMqtt5ConsumerActor with necessary parameters such as connection ID, message processor, source, dry run flag, and MQTT specific configuration.

methods.name: getPublishMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of messages this actor handles, which is Mqtt5Publish.

methods.name: extractHeadersMapFromMqttMessage
methods.description: Extracts headers from the MQTT message, including correlation data, response topic, content type, and user properties, to prepare headers for downstream processing.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload from the MQTT message as an optional ByteBuffer.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Gets the MQTT topic string from the message.

methods.name: getQoS
methods.description: Returns the QoS level of the MQTT message.

methods.name: isRetain
methods.description: Indicates whether the MQTT message is retained.

methods.name: sendPubAck
methods.description: Acknowledges the MQTT message by calling its acknowledge method.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Provides an enforcement filter based on headers or topic, if applicable, for message validation or policy enforcement.
